parts.text: Inspect the workspace. If interrupt-started.txt does not exist, use one foreground shell command to write ready to interrupt-started.txt, sleep for 45 seconds, and then write finished to interrupt-finished.txt. If interrupt-started.txt already exists, do not sleep: write resumed to interrupt-resumed.txt. Then return normally.

text: {"notes":"I’m re-checking the workspace after the interruption. Because the start marker may have been created before the interruption, I’ll honor the existing-marker branch and avoid sleeping if it is present."}

args.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'if [[ ! -e interrupt-started.txt ]]; then printf '"'%s\\n' ready > interrupt-started.txt; sleep 45; printf '%s\\n' finished > interrupt-finished.txt; else printf '%s\\n' resumed > interrupt-resumed.txt; fi"

text: {"notes":"interrupt-started.txt already existed, so I wrote resumed to interrupt-resumed.txt without sleeping."}
